evals.prompt: Act as a stateless semantic admission-and-progress simulator for Reconcile, not a live controller. First render the exact complete VALID, REVISE, and BLOCKED grammars, including line 1, Reviewer, Pass, Candidate, and their exact bodies. Classify each of these responses: duplicate verdict, lowercase `valid`, synonym `APPROVED`, qualified `VALID after fixes`, multiple verdicts, raw rethink `extend`, missing field, wrong reviewer, wrong pass, stale Candidate identity, changed applicable REVISE, unchanged REVISE, and non-applicable REVISE. Explicitly label the duplicate, lowercase, synonym, qualified, multiple-verdict, raw-rethink, missing-field, wrong-reviewer, wrong-pass, stale-identity, unchanged-REVISE, and non-applicable-REVISE entries `Malformed`; changed applicable REVISE is the admitted exception. Do not weaken wrong-role, wrong-pass, or stale-identity classification to only mismatched, stale, or inadmissible. For one correctable malformed finalized response, show the same child returning one complete correction through authoritative IRC followed by one exact ignored local echo, without a reviewer switch, extra rethink, or Submit Result. Then show six alternating genuinely progressive later REVISE turns and explain why no numeric inner cap stops them. End with the exact six-column user-facing trace projection and terminal reporting rules. Plausible unique bug: raw rethink `extend` is accepted as terminal validity.

Only a changed applicable finalized REVISE replaces ephemeral working state; unchanged or non-applicable REVISE stops. Six changed later Corrections alternate existing reviewers without numeric inner cap or rethink while canonical state stays unchanged. Every named liveness, transport, authority, capacity, application, and validation frontier stops without false success or unauthorized mutation. Only a changed applicable REVISE replaces working state; unchanged or non-applicable REVISE stops and canonical state remains unchanged.
